text:
Frida: Short one  signoff scramble: we have 9 managers pending and three confirmed OOO during the final 24h. Need a lightweight protocol so calibration export stays clean.
PeopleOpsBot: Current export: pending_signoffs_2023.csv. Pending: 9, OOO: 3. Reminder scheduled in 45m.
Noel: What's the threshold to extend vs force delegation? Last cycle we got dragged into a 72h delay which broke downstream meetings.
Kara: Proposal: if >=7 explicit delegation requests OR >20% managers still pending at T-24h -> extend 48h. Otherwise require delegation and People Ops assigns backups after a 2h grace. Keeps schedule tight.
Devon: Agreed. Also, can we add a visible "delegate_acceptance" line in the form so delegates explicitly accept? If form change is slow, require acceptance pasted to the form comment for this cycle.
Frida: For this cycle: require the delegate to paste: "I accept delegated review for <employee> (dates)." People Ops will add delegate_acceptance column in export.
Noel: We should add a minimal audit surface in the export: delegated=true/false, delegated_by, delegated_reviewer, delegate_reason (travel/hiring/emergency), delegate_acceptance, delegation_confirmed_ts. That way calibration leads can filter easily.
Kara: Also add a short rule for rating diffs: if delegate changes rating vs manager draft, set rating_diff=true and delegate must add a 1-line rationale in the comment. Those rows get flagged for manager confirmation before packet publish.
Frida: Good. And a template for manager comment when delegating so we get consistent metadata. Copyable message: "Delegating signoff for <employee> to <delegate> while OOO <dates>. Delegate acceptance: paste acceptance line below. Delegate brief: <1-2 bullets>."
Devon: Can People Ops also surface a tiny "exception_flag" column for late edits and a link to exception_log row? Helpful for calibration leads to see any post-deadline changes.
Frida: Yes. We'll include exception_flag and exception_row_id columns. Small edits allowed with attestation; rating changes post-deadline require HR review.
PeopleOpsBot: Template attestation added: /templates/attestation_late_edit.txt. Redaction reminder: remove PII before sharing calibration packets.
Noel: Operationally, I'll start assigning backups for the teams I own after the 2h grace. If a manager confirms delegation in the form we'll skip my manual assignment.
Kara: I'll draft a 4-line checklist for delegates to paste in thread and a short playbook flow image for the docs repo. Simple checklist: accept in form, read manager bullets (3 examples), add DELEGATED: prefix to calibration notes, flag rating diffs.
Devon: One more edge: if a delegated reviewer later becomes unavailable (e.g., gets pulled into interviews), fallback order should be: original manager -> delegated reviewer -> People Ops backup -> director-approved fallback. Export should capture final_confirmed_reviewer.
Frida: Noted. I'll add final_confirmed_reviewer and delegation_resolution_ts to the export. People Ops will reconcile and publish final CSV to calibration leads with flags.
Noel: If we hit the extension threshold, please post to calibration leads + update PeopleOpsBot schedule and the packet publish time. We should also email leads with the reason (e.g., "7 delegations triggered 48h extension").
Kara: For transparency, add a short blurb at the top of the packet when published: what changed (delegations, exceptions, extensions) and contact points. Helps avoid confusion in the meeting.
Frida: Agreed. I'll send manager ping now asking for out:dates/delegate acceptance. If no reply in 2h, People Ops will start manual backups. Will post final plan in this thread.
PeopleOpsBot: Manager ping sent: /pings/signoff_window_2023. Reminder in 45m.
Noel: I'll take 2 signoffs now and update when done.
Kara: Draft playbook link: /docs/perf/delegation-playbook-draft.md. Will iterate and attach flow image.
Frida: Thanks all  closing loop for now. Will post CSV of final assignments when reconciled. :white_check_mark:
